rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent of “otherwise” when warning what will happen if a condition is not met.

example.english: Leave quickly, else you'll miss the last train.
example.traditional: 快啲走，唔係就趕唔上尾班車。
example.jyutping: faai3 di1 zau2 m4 hai6 zau6 gon2 m4 soeng5 mei5 baan1 ce1

rows.note: Use this in questions such as “How else can it be done?” when asking what other way is possible.

example.english: Apart from taking a taxi, how else can I get to the airport?
example.traditional: 除咗搭的士，我仲可以點樣去機場？
example.jyutping: ceoi4 zo2 daap3 dik1 si2 ngo5 zung6 ho2 ji5 dim2 joeng2 heoi3 gei1 coeng4
